summary: We have created an educational website for everyone, with a focus on a younger audience, to learn about abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars. The site also includes a link to a gaming section where users can test and reinforce their knowledge, as well as play a game about finding abandoned rovers. Visitors can explore the surfaces of the Moon and Mars and discover the exact locations where our abandoned—but not forgotten—spacecraft have landed. Additionally, space explorers can see what these devices looked like and, in the game, help RobRob2 transport them back to Earth to display them at a museum. So, join us on this cosmic adventure of discovery!
details:
Our project gives us an opportunity to explore the Moon and Mars in order to learn about abandoned equipment. Explorers of all ages can use the site to broaden their knowledge about past projects of NASA. They can also try out the game, collect this equipment, and send it back to earth to display in a museum for people to see and to understand the problem of space debris. Many pictures that you can explore were drawn in painting app.

Applied programs:

-          Figma (site development)

-          Gdevelop 5 (game development)

-          FireAlpaca64 (painting app)

-          Canva (presentation and video editor)

 

Highlits:

-          Educational freedom: site and game to try different types of educational entertainment, so explorers can choose their own way to experience this journey!

-          Visual: drawn equipment for explorers to enjoy.

-          Simplisity: easy to understand mechanics.
